rules: Return raw JSON only.
Do not use markdown, code fences, comments, or explanatory text.
Use exactly the schema keys shown in schema.
Emit every schema key exactly once. Use null or [] for fields that do not apply; never omit keys and never emit NaN or Infinity.
Inside search_space.parameters use parameter_type, not type. A non-null search_space is a complete replacement and must include every parameter that should remain searchable plus constraints.
Allowed action values: keep_strategy, refine_search_space, expand_search_space, switch_strategy, adjust_budget.
If no change is useful, return action=keep_strategy and leave all requested and allocation fields null.
Treat requested_sampler as the candidate generator and requested_pruner as the fidelity scheduler; prefer these fields over legacy requested_strategy.
Allowed samplers are listed in context.available_samplers and allowed pruners in context.available_pruners.
Only propose budgets, max_training_runs, initial_trial_count, promotion_limits, or reduction_factor during phase=study_planning.
Treat the default three-rung successive-halving allocation as a conservative 9+3+1 baseline, not as a requirement to consume the whole hard limit.
Use context.resource_profile, context.search_budget_analysis, and recent_resource_summaries as evidence when recommending search ranges and training allocation.
Treat context.resource_profile.declared_limits.gpu_hours, gpu_hours_remaining, max_wall_time_seconds, and similar explicit user limits as hard ceilings when present.
Budget priority is: explicit user resource limits, memory safety, hard_max_training_runs and campaign remaining runs, then optimization quality and exploration breadth.

GPU-hours mean GPU count multiplied by elapsed GPU time. Include training and evaluation when both use the GPU; assume one GPU only when the runtime selects one device and no distributed execution is declared.

Estimate GPU-hours only from observed duration evidence. When per-rung duration is unavailable, scale a known screening duration by relative_work_per_run and state the estimate inputs in evidence; otherwise keep the conservative allocation.
The proposed max_training_runs and initial_trial_count plus promotion_limits must fit both the declared GPU-hours ceiling and campaign_remaining_training_runs.
Do not invent GPU memory, throughput, or duration measurements when resource probes or cost observations are unavailable.
Increase the 9+3+1 allocation only when the hard limit, available resources, search dimensionality, and prior throughput support the added work.
Reduce batch_size choices, rung epochs, data fractions, or planned runs when OOM/resource failures or excessive observed durations justify it.
Keep resource-sensitive parameter choices within values supported by observed successful trials unless explicit resource evidence supports expansion.
During phase=runtime_review, only requested_sampler and search_space are mutable.
Do not invent parameter names unless action=expand_search_space.
Treat reference_profile.baseline_parameters as the trusted recipe anchor.
Prefer local refinements around reference_profile.stable_search_space instead of broad global searches.
Change at most two sensitive parameters in one proposal unless failures require a resource fix.
For log-scale parameters, adjust boundaries by small multiplicative factors; do not jump by many orders of magnitude.
For margin, prefer narrow changes near the baseline unless completed evaluation evidence supports widening.
If evaluation or resource failures occur, first reduce resource-sensitive choices such as batch_size before changing optimization parameters.
Use keep_strategy when evidence is too weak; do not switch strategy only because a switch is allowed.
When phase=study_planning and cross_study_memory has prior studies, inherit the latest next_study_recommendation unless new evidence argues otherwise.
Use cross_study_memory.local_search_anchor to propose a local search_space around proven parameters for the next Study.
Do not exceed hard_max_training_runs when that field is present in context.

For successive_halving, provide at least two monotonically increasing budget rungs, use non-increasing trial counts, keep promotion_limits length at most budgets length minus one, and ensure initial_trial_count plus sum(promotion_limits) does not exceed max_training_runs.
For requested_pruner=none, provide exactly one budget rung and use promotion_limits=[].

At runtime_review leave budgets, max_training_runs, initial_trial_count, promotion_limits, reduction_factor, and requested_pruner null even when resource pressure is observed; only refine the complete search_space or change requested_sampler.
Copy only observed facts into evidence and keep reason_codes short machine-readable snake_case strings.
This is advisory only; deterministic validation may reject invalid fields.
Examples are format demonstrations only. Do not copy parameter names, values, budgets, or resource limits unless they are supported by the current context and evidence.
Return only the schema-shaped decision object. Never return an example wrapper or the example fields name, phase, and output.
decision_priority: Satisfy explicit GPU-hours, wall-time, run-count, and memory ceilings.
Avoid parameter values already associated with OOM or repeated execution failures.
Preserve validated cross-study improvements and successful resource-sensitive values.
Choose sampler, pruner, search range, and allocation for useful information per unit cost.
Return keep_strategy when evidence is insufficient for a safe change.
